content.overview: Consideration is something done, forborne, or promised at the desire of the promisor. Agreements without consideration are void unless they fall within section 25 exceptions.

sections.heading: Definition
sections.body: Section 2(d) defines consideration. Commercial adequacy is not required. Past consideration at the desire of the promisor can support a promise under Indian law in recognised settings.

sections.heading: Section 25 exceptions
sections.body: Natural love and affection (writing and registered, near relation); compensation for past voluntary services; promise to pay a time-barred debt. Conditions must be strictly met.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: If lack of consideration is pleaded, answer with 2(d) facts or a 25 exception. Moral obligation alone is not consideration outside the statute.
